references.text: Describes the division of peoples after Noah's descendants, where the earth was divided in Peleg's days
Tells how the Lord scattered people over the whole earth after Babel and set boundaries for the nations
Refers to how God has assigned the host of heaven to all peoples under the heavens
Describes how God makes nations great and destroys them, expands nations and leads them away
Speaks of the sons of God who judge the peoples, and God's inheritance over the nations
Paul explains that God created all peoples from one man and set times and boundaries for their dwelling places
Refers to angelic princes over nations, suggesting heavenly beings connected to the peoples
Mentions the prince of Persia and Greece, referring to heavenly beings over nations
Israel is God's treasured possession among all peoples, a holy nation – highlighting Israel's special position
